evals.name: Python PDF library search
evals.prompt: find me a python library for parsing PDF files on github
evals.expected_output: Repository search results with star counts, descriptions, language

evals.name: JS fetch API code search
evals.prompt: search github for code examples of using the fetch api with error handling in javascript
evals.expected_output: Code search results with snippets, file paths, repo links
assertions: Result includes code snippets with error handling
Each result links to a GitHub repo

evals.name: React compiler issues
evals.prompt: are there any open issues on facebook/react about the new compiler?
evals.expected_output: Issues search results with issue numbers, titles, state, labels
assertions: Result includes issue titles and numbers

evals.name: Trending Rust projects
evals.prompt: find me the top trending rust projects on github this month
evals.expected_output: Repository search with star counts, language filter, sorted by stars
assertions: Result includes repos with star counts
